products.name: Pain Au Chocolat

testimonials.name: Ananya Sharma
testimonials.comment: The Belgian Dark Chocolate Fudge cake was the star of our anniversary dinner! Truly French patisserie quality in Mumbai. Delivery on WhatsApp was seamless!

testimonials.name: Rohan Mehta
testimonials.comment: As a sourdough fanatic, their Artisanal Country Loaf is hands down the best in the city. Incredible blistered crust, airy crumb, and fantastic sourdough aroma!

testimonials.name: Priya Kapoor
testimonials.comment: We ordered 50 mini croissant boxes for a corporate breakfast. Every single croissant was golden, flaky, and buttery. Aura Bakery is now our official partner!

faqs.question: How do I place an order on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Simply add your favorite baked goods to the cart, click checkout, fill in your delivery details, and tap 'Order on WhatsApp'. It instantly opens WhatsApp with your itemized summary ready to send!

faqs.question: Are your products freshly baked daily?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every loaf of bread, croissant, cake, and cookie is baked fresh every morning by our master bakers using 100% natural and unbleached ingredients.

faqs.question: Do you offer eggless options?
faqs.answer: Yes! Over 80% of our products—including our best-selling Belgian Chocolate Fudge cake, brownies, donuts, sourdoughs, and cookies—are 100% eggless. Look for the 'Eggless' badge on items.

faqs.question: What is the delivery radius and fee?
faqs.answer: We deliver across Mumbai & surrounding areas. Delivery is flat ₹50, and FREE for all orders above ₹800.

faqs.question: Can I request custom cake designs or message toppings?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! After placing your order on WhatsApp, you can share custom message requirements, reference images, or special dietary notes directly with our head pastry chef.
